Packaging and printing.analogy: Spot AI describes an anonymous packaging manufacturer's use of video to review changeovers. Transferable discovery topic: setup and material handoffs. The customer and results are vendor-reported, not independently verified.
Packaging and printing.limit: A printing or packaging prospect is not known to have this problem. Small text, print registration and seal defects can need dedicated inspection cameras.

Food processing.analogy: Intenseye publishes food-plant scenarios involving visible access, protective clothing and movement around processing/packing areas. This is a product offering, not evidence these prospects have bought AI.
Food processing.limit: Ordinary CCTV cannot prove microbial cleanliness, food temperature or chemical safety. Begin with an observable handling or zone event.

Garments and textiles.analogy: Intenseye documents an anonymous thread manufacturer's use of camera analytics for traffic, housekeeping and area controls. Garment handoff timing is a related hypothesis, not the documented outcome of that case.
Garments and textiles.limit: Worker presence is not productivity. Stitching quality and fine fabric defects may not be visible on existing CCTV.

Metalworking and machinery.analogy: Voxel's Piston Automotive case describes camera-based workplace safety in an automotive plant. Similar visible access and material-handling questions can be explored at metalworking factories.
Metalworking and machinery.limit: A small fabrication shop is not equivalent to an automotive plant. Do not assume forklifts or standard cycles exist; measure the actual workflow.

Furniture and wood.analogy: Spot AI's manufacturing page includes a named Elite Comfort Solutions testimonial about facility hazards. This supports exploring visual safety and handling around furniture production, not an exact product-fit claim.
Furniture and wood.limit: Cutting, finishing and furniture assembly differ from foam/bedding production. Surface finish and hidden joints need other inspection methods.

Electrical and electronics.analogy: Retrocausal describes teaching and monitoring assembly processes from video. It supports exploring visible station handoffs or step completion; setup and validation remain process-specific.
Electrical and electronics.limit: PCB defects, electrical function and correct torque cannot generally be established by ceiling CCTV. Avoid making them the initial offer.

Plastics.analogy: Spot AI's manufacturing offering includes workstation events and workflow analysis. Applying these to moulding, trimming and packing is a cross-process inference, not a named plastics-client result.
Plastics.limit: Automatic moulding can legitimately run unattended. Define the expected intervention before classifying a delay.

Heat treatment.analogy: Kenesis's own rubber-curing pilot provides an adjacent timing pattern: process ready, then material removed. The transfer to metal treatment is an engineering hypothesis, not proven compatibility.
Heat treatment.limit: The linked vendor offering supports general visual workflow analysis only. Furnace readiness, cooling requirements and metallurgical quality need authoritative process evidence.
